name: A Dwarf and His Tools
summary: Prospector Ryedol warns that Dark Iron dwarves, looking like the Shadowforge clan, are all around. They just attacked the dig site where Ryedol worked, and Ryedol wants the lucky pick back.

sections.title: Raiders at the Dig
sections.body: Dark Iron dwarves of the Shadowforge clan, by Prospector Ryedol's account, have attacked the excavation site where Ryedol worked. They killed nearly everyone, Ryedol's boss Hammertoe among them, and Ryedol barely escaped with life intact. The site lies to the north of Ryedol's position.

sections.title: A Lucky Pick
sections.body: Ryedol is working out how to win back some of the lost supplies, above all his lucky pick. One of the Dark Iron must be carrying it, though it could be any of them. Ryedol hopes you will help, and waits south of Hammertoe's Dig Site.

aliases: who gives a dwarf and his tools
faq.answer: Ryedol worked at an excavation site that Dark Iron dwarves attacked. He barely escaped and now waits south of Hammertoe's Dig Site.
Dark Iron dwarves who looked to be of the Shadowforge clan.
Hammertoe was Ryedol's boss, and was among those killed in the attack.

faq.q: Where is the lucky pick located?
faq.answer: Ryedol believes one of the Dark Iron has it, though it could be any of them.
